## Contribution checklist

- [ ] My contribution commits include matching DCO `Signed-off-by` trailers
      (`git commit -s`).
- [ ] My contribution commits have GitHub-verified signatures (`git commit -S`).
- [ ] I ran relevant local checks and added or updated tests for behavior changes.
- [ ] I updated affected documentation, examples and schemas.
- [ ] I reviewed the
      [contribution and merge requirements](https://github.com/OSSAfrica/skillguard/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
